body:
This will cause infinite recursion, did you test this code?

There's no case for `PRESET_CUSTOM` so it will enter the default case and call itself, again, and again, and since it doesn't exit early if setting the preset to `PRESET_CUSTOM` it will never stop
I can remove the recursion but in testing the code I was unable to trigger it in anyway
So what happens when you set it to `PRESET_CUSTOM`?

Within the Physics Material it changes the dropdown text to Custom and allows you to edit the properties.

Changing the friction and bounce of other presets also set it to PRESET_CUSTOM and doesn't seem to cause an issue.

The changes to friction and bounce go through as well and are observed on the rigid bodies after loading the scene.
